The '''Falley Club''' was one of a number of exclusive private clubs on [[Estalle Island]]. The establishment, located on the planet [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]], was over one thousand years old during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and catered for the most important noble families in [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani]] society.

Membership to the Falley Club was not linked with [[Tapani Noble Houses|house]] affiliation but to prevent unpleasant rivalries house partisans and firebrands tended to be discouraged from joining. The club favored intellectuals, academics and military careerists.
